title.en: HR Rising Fast on Flat Ground

tip.en: You're on flat terrain at ~5:07 pace yet HR has jumped from 149 to 153 bpm in just 10 seconds—your cardiovascular system is loading faster than the effort warrants. This is early evidence the body isn't settled today.
tip.zh: 此处地形平坦、配速约5:07，但10秒内心率从149跳至153，心血管负荷明显超出运动强度。这是今天身体状态尚未稳定的早期信号。

tip.en: HR hits 171 and pace briefly touches 3:11—but the surrounding 20 seconds show erratic pace readings (7:35, 9:55, 6:13) suggesting a GPS glitch or sharp direction change rather than a true sprint. Yet HR continues rising to 179 through this zone. The mismatch between pace noise and sustained cardiac stress is a flag worth monitoring.
tip.zh: 此处心率达171且配速瞬间出现3:11，但前后20秒配速数据混乱（7:35、9:55、6:13），可能是GPS偏移或急转弯。然而心率随后持续升至179，配速与心脏负荷的背离值得关注。

title.zh: 179次/分心率上限——平路中等配速

tip.en: Max HR of 179 is reached here at 5:33 pace on essentially flat ground—a heart rate more typical of your hard interval efforts from recent history, not a 6:08 avg-pace prep run. Something external (heat, fatigue, caffeine, stress) is amplifying cardiac response today. File this for pre-race monitoring.
tip.zh: 此处以5:33配速在平地跑出179次/分的最高心率，这通常出现在你近期的高强度间歇训练中，而非均速6:08的准备跑。外部因素（高温、疲劳、咖啡因或压力）可能放大了今天的心脏反应，建议赛前重点关注。

title.en: HR Retreating — System Finding Its Floor
title.zh: 心率回落——身体开始自我调节

tip.en: From 179 at km 1.3, HR has dropped to 177 and will continue falling through this zone—pace has also eased to ~5:45. The body is self-regulating after the spike, which is a healthy sign, but the 25+ bpm drop over 500m of flat running tells you the earlier ceiling was a stress response, not fitness-driven effort.
tip.zh: 从1.3公里处的179次/分，心率已下降至177并持续回落，配速也放缓至约5:45。身体在骤升后开始自我调节，这是良好信号，但在500米平路上心率下降超过25次/分，说明此前的峰值是应激反应而非体能驱动。

title.en: Second Stop — Pace Collapsing at km 2.1
title.zh: 第二次停顿——2.1公里处配速骤降

tip.en: Pace slows to 9:41 then null for ~30 seconds while HR drops from 149 to 127 during the standstill. This is the second mid-run pause (the first was near km 0.8). Two unplanned stops in a 3.75 km prep run signal the body or mind wasn't ready for sustained running today—useful data before a race.
tip.zh: 配速降至9:41后出现约30秒空值，心率同步从149降至127。这是本次跑步的第二次中途停顿（第一次在约0.8公里处）。3.75公里的准备跑中出现两次非计划停顿，说明今天身体或心理状态不适合持续跑动——这是赛前的重要参考信息。

tip.en: Grade hits -11% here near the high point of the run (altitude ~8m), dropping sharply over ~20m of distance. HR stays controlled at 138-139—your downhill mechanics are relaxed and efficient, which is encouraging for race-day descents even if the climbs raised flags.
tip.zh: 此处坡度达-11%，位于全程最高点（海拔约8米）附近，约20米内急剧下降。心率平稳保持在138-139次/分，下坡跑姿放松高效，这对比赛日的下坡段是个积极信号，尽管上坡段暴露了一些问题。

title.zh: 第三次停顿——疲劳模式持续显现

tip.en: Pace reads 22:44 and then null for over 20 seconds at km 3.2—a third pause in a sub-4 km run. HR at 139-141 during the stop suggests you're walking, not injured, but the repeated halts in what was billed as a prep run hint at accumulated fatigue from the 8 km track session two days ago.
tip.zh: 3.2公里处配速显示22:44后超过20秒无数据——这是不足4公里的跑步中第三次停顿。停顿时心率139-141，说明是步行而非受伤，但反复停顿提示两天前8公里场地跑的积累疲劳尚未完全消退。

tip.en: From here to the end (~145 seconds), pace readings are mostly above 9:00 or null and HR falls steadily from 142 to 108—this is essentially a walking cool-down for the final 0.05 km. Finishing with a deliberate walk-down is smart before a race, but the total running distance ended up well short of your recent 4–8 km history.
tip.zh: 从此处到结束（约145秒），配速大多超过9:00或无数据，心率从142平稳降至108——实际上是最后约0.05公里的步行放松。赛前进行步行放松是明智之举，但本次实际跑步距离明显少于近期4-8公里的训练量。
